title: Console cost dashboard: release choreography, micro-training, and escalation playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinated launch plan for the new Console Cost Breakdown dashboard feature. This ticket covers release choreography across PM/Eng/Design/Docs/Support, a micro-training curriculum for internal teams, the customer-facing release notes blurb, and an escalation playbook for post-launch anomalies (cost regressions, telemetry gaps, or rollout failures).
goals: Ensure console cost dashboard ships with clear customer messaging and measurable adoption targets
Equip support, sales engineering, and CSMs with a 20-minute micro-training and 1-page cheatsheet
Define escalation paths and automated alerts for any cost telemetry regressions within the first 7 days
milestones: 2025-02-11: Draft release notes and feature blurb complete
2025-02-14: Design assets and micro-training deck signed off
2025-02-16: Observability hooks + feature flag gated rollout in staging
2025-02-20: Docs published and support runbook distributed
launch_steps: PM: finalize customer-facing blurb and target messaging (Ava)
Design: finalize dashboard microcopy + screenshots for release notes (Priya)
Eng: implement feature-flag gating, telemetry events, and alert thresholds (Diego / Nikhil)
Docs: short-form quickstart + 1-page cheatsheet for SE/Support (Samira)
Support: tabletop run-through and escalation contract review (Maya)
Sales Eng: prepare 30-min demo script and FAQs (Jordan)
PMPS: coordinate customer comms list and timing (Ava)
Launch: canary (10% customers) -> region waves with rollback window (Eng ops)
Post-launch: 48h monitoring window with automatic rollback criteria
training_plan: Module 0 (10m): What changed — feature summary + ideal use cases
Module 1 (20m): Walkthrough of dashboard — filters, cost attribution, and comparison views
Module 2 (15m): Troubleshooting common anomalies and interpreting telemetry
Module 3 (15m): Escalation flow and SLAs — when to open an incident vs support ticket
comms_matrix: Internal - All-Hands email: high-level announcement + link to microtraining (owner: PM)
Internal - Support Slack channel: runbook + escalation playbook (owner: Support Lead)
External - Release notes page: feature blurb + screenshots (owner: Docs)
External - Customer newsletter: targeted subset with beta opt-in (owner: Growth)
External - Help center article: quickstart + FAQ (owner: Docs)
Sales Eng - enablement: 30-min live session + replay link (owner: Sales Eng)
Developer - changelog and SDK notes: API names and telemetry events (owner: Engineering)
Monitoring - Pager rotation: alert routing and contact list (owner: SRE)
Feedback - product-feedback channel: capture customer usability issues (owner: PM)
Localization - i18n schedule: target locales and deadlines (owner: Localization PM)
release_notes_blurb: New: Cost Breakdown dashboard — see per-route and per-model token costs, customizable groupings, and quick comparisons across time ranges. Designed to surface unit economics and identify high-cost outliers. Available in Console for all paid accounts; toggleable via feature flag for staged rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry event coverage >= 95% for dashboard interactions in staging
Docs and release notes published and linked in console release banner
Support and SE teams completed micro-training and acknowledged runbook
Canary rollout executed with no critical regressions for 48h
Automated alerts for cost deviation configured (thresholds and on-call routing)
risks: Cost telemetry under-reporting causing incorrect cost attribution
High-traffic queries produce increased latency in dashboard rendering
Customer confusion about cost units leading to support volume spike
Rollout gating misconfiguration exposes feature to unintended customers
mitigations: Telemetry: add redundant events and a daily reconciliation job to catch gaps
Performance: enforce query timeouts and limit default time window to 7 days
Docs/Comms: include explicit unit examples (per-token, per-embed) and in-dashboard tooltips
Rollout: require two-person approval to lift feature flag from canary to global
